priorities.name: Critical
priorities.description: Immediate action required — student safety at risk, legal obligation, or regulatory breach

priorities.name: High
priorities.description: Urgent attention required — significant impact on student welfare, campus security, or institutional reputation

priorities.name: Medium
priorities.description: Needs timely follow-up — moderate impact on academic operations or campus environment

priorities.name: Low
priorities.description: Can be addressed in routine workflow — minimal disruption to campus operations

priorities.name: Informational
priorities.description: For documentation and awareness only — no immediate corrective action required
